prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and the types of services you need. I can help pick the best match for you, but first I need a few details.

Quick questions
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, PR, SEO, social media, creative/branding, etc.)
- What industry are you in?
- Approximate monthly or project budget?
- Do you need local/regional presence in Maryland (onsite meetings) or is remote OK?
- Any must‑have capabilities? (e.g., B2B experience, HIPAA/healthcare compliance, ecommerce platforms, video production)
- Timeline / when do you want to start?

How I can help once you answer
- Provide a tailored shortlist of 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs, with their specialties, typical client size, and why they fit.
- Draft an outreach/RFP template you can send to chosen agencies.
- Suggest vetting questions and a scoring checklist so you can compare proposals.

If you prefer to search yourself
- Use review and listing sites: Clutch.co, UpCity, G2, and Google My Business. Filter by services, hourly rates, and location.
- Look for case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, revenue).
- Check client testimonials, LinkedIn company pages, and local business awards (Baltimore Business Journal, Maryland/DC marketing awards).
- Request references and a short pilot project before committing to a long contract.

Tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll put together a curated list and outreach materials.
